summary: Modulprüfungsordnung Musik L1 of 30.01.2023, section 5 (Langfach): modules 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8 and 9 are compulsory, and students follow one instrument line, 2A with 5A or 2B with 5B (5 ECTS each), continuing in 5B the profile chosen inside 2B. Section 5 (3) counts module 6, one grade from module 7 or module 8, and module 9 toward the state exam, and both module 7 and module 8 stay compulsory.

options.id: Modul 2a Instrumente spielen - selbst und mit Kindern 1
Modul 2b Instrumente spielen - selbst und mit Kindern 1

categories.name: Playing instruments 1 (2A or 2B)
categories.note: Choose module 2A or module 2B (5 ECTS). The same line continues in module 5: 2A with 5A, or 2B with 5B and the profile chosen inside 2B.

categories.name: Playing instruments 2 (5A or 5B)
categories.note: Choose module 5A or module 5B (5 ECTS). Module 5A requires completed module 2A, and module 5B requires completed module 2B with that same profile.
